jobs.title: Consultant, FP&A Supply Chain Corporate, APAC
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary:

Role Type: Individual Contributor
Primary Location: Tokyo, Japan

At The Coca Cola Company, our ambition is to refresh the world and make a difference, and finance plays a critical role in bringing that vision to life. As part of our Finance Hub, the FP&A Supply Chain Corporate team ensures the integrity, transparency, and efficiency of key financial processes that enable the entire system to thrive. In this role, you will contribute to accurate product costing and pricing processes, delivering insights that support innovation and operational excellence across multiple regions. By leveraging your analytical expertise and digital fluency, you will help optimize supply chain transparency, standardize processes, and build efficiencies that support growth across emerging and established markets. If you are passionate about finance, technology, and improving global processes in a collaborative and forward-thinking organization, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact within one of the world’s most recognized brands.

What You will do for us
- Prepare, release, and maintain product standard costs and related SAP master data for new product launches or reformulations for assigned plant locations, ensuring accurate and timely communication to stakeholders.
- Execute re‑costing of materials based on Bill of Material changes, analyzing cost impacts and validating results for assigned plants.
- Lead Pricing and Purchase Price Variance (PPV) processes for assigned locations, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure pricing compliance and accuracy.
- Oversee daily deliverables from third‑party service providers for pricing and accounting tasks, validating work against internal controls and corrective action standards.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for costing and pricing escalations, applying a broad perspective to resolve complex issues.
- Coordinate internal and external audit requirements relating to costing, revenue, and volume reporting, maintaining proper documentation and compliance standards.
- Promote consistent application of global standards and best practices in cost and pricing management, partnering with regional teams for continuous improvements.
- Reconcile and monitor Cost of Goods Sold clearing account balances for timely recognition of financial results.
- Drive process optimization by identifying opportunities for enhancement, preparing performance metrics, and facilitating alignment across teams.
- Act as finance subject‑matter contributor on global initiatives such as S/4HANA deployments and other supply chain transformations, ensuring finance requirements are effectively represented.

Requirements and Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; equivalent practical experience accepted.
- Minimum of 5 years’ progressive experience in finance, accounting, or supply chain costing roles.
- Professional accounting designation (CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
- Proven proficiency in SAP or similar integrated manufacturing systems.
- Strong digital and data literacy, including the ability to leverage analytics for decision support and process efficiency.
- Fluency in English; Additional languages such as Japanese is preferred.
- Ability to build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and manage external service provider performance.
- Demonstrated growth mindset with experience in driving process improvements and embracing transformation initiatives.
- Skilled in managing competing priorities, analyzing complex data, and applying problem‑solving to supply chain challenges.

What We’ll Do for You
- Enable you to work on regional and global initiatives that directly support Coca‑Cola’s supply chain and operational strategies.
- Provide exposure to digital transformation projects that shape how finance operates globally, expanding your technical capabilities.
- Offer robust development opportunities including mentorship, cross‑market collaboration, and access to the company’s learning platforms.
- Connect you with a dynamic and diverse team focused on continuous improvement, innovation, and process standardization.

Skills for Workday
- Financial Planning & Analysis
- Cost Accounting and Product Costing
- SAP and ERP System Proficiency
- Data Analysis and Insight Generation
- Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement
- Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement
- Digital Fluency and Technology Adoption
- Problem‑Solving and Root Cause Analysis
- Adaptability and Change Orientation
- Communication and Collaboration

Skills:
Accounts Payable Process, Communication, Cost Accounting, Customer Service, ERP Solutions, Financial Accounting, Financial Forecasting, General Ledger (GL), Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Global SAP, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI), Preparation of Financial Reports, Process Reviews, Tax Legislation, Teamwork, Troubleshooting

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Commercial Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary:

At The Coca‑Cola Company, we create beverages that inspire moments of refreshment and connection while shaping a future built on sustainability and innovation. Our U.S. Juice and Warehouse Route-to-Market portfolio, which includes beloved brands like Simply and Minute Maid, plays a critical role in the company’s growth strategy. We are seeking a Senior Manager, Commercial Strategy & Operations who will help drive category leadership and operational excellence from strategy through execution.

This role combines strategic thinking with action orientation, serving as a key partner in developing commercial strategies aligned with consumer, category, and customer priorities. You will influence how our products gain availability, visibility, and performance in market—while supporting innovation commercialization and SKU productivity across one of Coca‑Cola’s most competitive categories. If you bring analytical rigor, operational discipline, and a collaborative mindset, this role offers the opportunity to enhance executional performance and accelerate growth within a high-impact business segment.

What You’ll Do for Us
- Drive development and support execution of commercial strategies tailored to category needs, shopper insights, and customer expectations to strengthen portfolio growth.

- Collaborate with Brand, RGM, Channel Strategy, and Supply Chain teams to align strategic priorities and translate them into actionable market and customer plans.

- Support AMPS (Availability, Merchandising, Pricing, Space) strategy to optimize product visibility, pricing structures, and merchandising programs across channels.

- Conduct analysis on SKU productivity, profitability, and order-of-entry planning to enable informed decision-making and portfolio optimization.

- Leverage syndicated data (IRI/Nielsen), shopper studies, and internal performance dashboards to identify trends, competitive activity, and actionable insights.

- Serve as a key partner in commercialization planning for innovation launches, overseeing executional timelines and cross-functional coordination from concept through deployment.

- Manage annual innovation sample process, ensuring timely allocation, delivery, and customer readiness for new product introductions.

- Facilitate recurring performance review routines and share scorecards to align stakeholders on progress and next steps for market execution.

- Identify operational gaps and opportunities for process improvement, channel efficiency, and execution enhancement across key growth platforms.

- Build trusted relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure collaborative delivery against established business objectives.

Requirements & Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field required; advanced degree preferred.

- 5+ years of experience in commercial strategy, category management, sales, or brand marketing within beverage or CPG industries.

- Demonstrated expertise connecting strategic objectives to operational execution while managing multiple priorities under fast-paced conditions.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills anchored in ability to use data resources (IRI/Nielsen, Power BI) for actionable insights and performance recommendations.

- Knowledge of pricing strategies, promotional frameworks, category management principles, and shopper marketing activation.

- Working familiarity with AMPS metrics and their role in driving distribution, merchandising, and visibility across retail environments.

- Proven experience in supporting SKU productivity initiatives and portfolio profitability analyses.

- Collaborative approach with effective communication skills to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders.

- Comfortable using digital tools and forecasting platforms; openness to leveraging AI-enabled capabilities for advanced analytics and automation.

- Offer exposure to cross-functional teams and key retail partners, accelerating your knowledge across sales, brand, and operational planning.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Finance
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary:

Job Summary :
Manage the day-to-day finance agenda for CPS Chile, ensuring accurate financial planning, cost control, working capital discipline, internal controls and strong support to plant operations. The role leads the local finance team and provides timely insights, analysis and execution support to the Finance Director South Region across Chile finance matters.
Partner closely with plant leadership, Operations, Supply Chain, Platform Services, CPS Center and KO Corporate teams to translate business needs into disciplined financial execution, clear performance routines, sound controls and practical recommendations that support local decision-making and regional priorities.

Key Duties/Responsibilities :
- Support the Finance Director South Region and local business routines by providing financial analysis, operational insights and disciplined follow-up on day-to-day plant priorities, business commitments and performance actions.
- Lead the local finance team of four direct reports, ensuring clear priorities, strong routines, capability development, engagement and effective execution of financial planning, accounting, cost and control activities.
- Coordinate the local execution of CPS Chile Regional Standards, annual business planning, rolling estimate and forecast processes, ensuring data quality, plant input integration and alignment with Finance Director South Region guidance.
- Monitor and support delivery of CPS Chile operating income, productivity, overheads, inventory and Operation Capital targets through plant-level financial analysis, cost tracking, performance routines and corrective action follow-up.
- Maintain strong presence in the plant’s day-to-day routines, partnering with Operations to understand production performance, conversion costs, inventory movements, losses, productivity opportunities and financial implications of operational decisions
- Ensure local implementation of audit, control policies and procedures to safeguard assets and maintain compliance. Coordinate evidence, testing, remediation and follow-up with Corporate Audit, external auditors, Platform Services and local process owners.
- Support tax, accounting and statutory matters by coordinating required local inputs with Corporate Tax, Platform Services and external partners, escalating key issues and recommendations to the Finance Director South Region when needed.
- Manage core local finance, accounting and internal control activities for CPS Chile by ensuring accurate local inputs, timely information flow, issue preparation and clear follow-up, enabling the Finance Director South Region to have effective interactions with Platform Services Financial Hub.
- Ensure Finance processes are executed with high standards, in compliance with Company requirements, and with a strong focus on value creation, productivity, process simplification and practical support to plant operations.
- Support CPS Chile transformation initiatives by providing financial analysis, tracking commitments, identifying risks and following up on agreed actions with local owners.
- Provide local financial inputs and execution support to CPS Center and KO Corporate initiatives, ensuring Chile requirements, risks and operational realities are properly reflected and escalated when appropriate.

Qualifications & Related Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree in BBA – Accounting, Finance or any related career. CPA and/or MBA.
- +7 years of finance experience in manufacturing, supply chain or operations environments, with exposure to financial planning, cost control, accounting, internal controls and people leadership.
- Experience executing annual business planning, rolling estimates, forecasting and performance tracking, including analysis of actual results versus budget and translation of financial data into clear operational insights.
- Ability to lead and develop a small local team, collaborate with cross-functional peers, manage priorities under pressure and ensure reliable execution of planning, reporting, closing and control routines.
- Strong understanding of KO financial processes, internal control expectations and plant economics, with the ability to connect operational performance with financial results and escalate relevant risks or opportunities.
- Fluent written and spoken English with strong communication skills required.  Ability to operate in multi-cultural environment.

- Thrive in Ambiguity: Embrace uncertainty as an opportunity for growth.

jobs.title: Senior Director, General Manager, Tea Company
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary:

The Coca-Cola Company, a global beverage leader with a rich history of 140 years and a portfolio of over 200 brands worldwide and TeaCo is a dedicated 'hothouse' tasked with step-change growth and disruptive innovation in the ready-to-drink tea category. Operating within a 'sandbox' (primarily Guangdong province, with initial focus on the Greater Guangzhou area), TeaCo is expected to:

•    Test creative ideas and new business models at startup speed.
•    Leverage the global scale of Coca-Cola and local execution strength of Swire
•    Deliver validated concepts that can scale back into the core ATH system or launch as independent brands.
•    Achieve +150M incremental unit cases over a 3-year horizon.

This is not a traditional internal functional leadership role. It requires entrepreneurial capability, commercial ownership, stakeholder management, and the ability to operate in ambiguity with pace. The position is legally hosted under Coca-Cola, reporting to the Synthetic Board, within a virtual entity structure where costs are shared proportionally between KO and Swire.

What You'll Do for Us:

Own the Innovation Agenda and Product Roadmap
•   Define the innovation strategy, prioritize concepts, and manage the pipeline from ideation to pilot launch
•   Lead consumer insight integration, concept development, and rapid prototyping
•   Ensure innovation efforts protect and enhance the ATH master brand equity
•    Build and test digitally enabled commercialization models, including digital consumer acquisition, O2O activation, DTC experimentation, social commerce, and platform partnerships.

Own Commercial and Financial Outcomes
•   Full P&L ownership for TeaCo — accountable for revenue, cost, margin, and investment returns
•    Build and refine the business model across incubation, early commercialization, and potential scale phases
•    Deliver against +150M unit cases 3-year target

Build and Lead a High-Performance, Lean Team
•    Recruit, develop, and retain a world-class, entrepreneurial team (1+4 structure).
•    Foster a culture of speed, experimentation, accountability, and psychological safety.
•    Attract talent willing to embrace a 60%+ failure rate on individual experiments (as a portfolio, the goal is success).

Manage Complex Stakeholder Ecosystem
•    Internal: Navigate Coca-Cola (Shanghai HQ, GDI (Global Development and Innovation), Consumer Insights, KO Legal), Swire (TAC, S&M, Supply Chain), and XNode (external facilitator).
•    External: Co-packers, ingredient suppliers, research agencies, advisory network.
•    Governance: Manage Board engagement, prepare for Gate Reviews, and ensure transparent progress reporting

Drive Speed-to-Market and Consumer Validation
•   Move from concept to consumer test in 90-day cycles where possible.
•    Build rapid feedback loops with target consumers in the Guangzhou test market.
•    Make "accelerate/ pivot/ pause/ stop" decisions with confidence and data.
•    Use digital channels and consumer data to test propositions, acquire target consumers, and accelerate product-market fit validation.
•    Run rapid experiments across digital targeting, product concepts, pricing, promotions, conversion pathways, and repeat purchase behavior.

Protect Brand Integrity and Ensure Governance Discipline

jobs.title: Plant General Manager (Dairy, Beverage Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary:

The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC). Our vision is loved brands done sustainably, for a better shared future. It’s an exciting time to work in The Coca-Cola Company’s flagship market. We’re accelerating our momentum as the fastest-growing large consumer goods company in North America by putting people at the heart of our business and everything we do!

The Peterborough Manufacturing Plant is key part of the North American Operating Unit of The Coca-Cola Company/Minute Maid.  This pivotal role involves steering the strategic direction and overseeing all aspect of Plant Management—including P&L Management, Production, Engineering, Quality, Safety, Environmental (QSE), and Operational Excellence. As the linchpin of our plant operations, you'll ensure the seamless continuity of supply, spearhead the execution of our annual business plan, and drive key program implementations. Your leadership will cultivate an atmosphere of operational excellence and collaborative teamwork, all within a customer-centric framework.

Key Responsibilities and Position-Related Functions
- Develop and execute 1-year and 3-year business plans in line with national, regional, and local objectives, including strategy, process, and program development.
- Lead and manage a team of direct reports while also providing inspirational leadership to a large number of indirect reports to maintain and further enhance employee engagement.  Will ensure that the right level of capability is developed and maintained within the Plant for now and for the future.  Will also identify, develop and grow the next generation of Local leaders through active performance management, coaching, feedback and the People Development Forum (PDF) process.
- Effectively communicate plant goals and objectives across all levels of the organization, ensuring alignment on relevant performance data.
- Be responsible for ensuring that the Plant achieves its annual business plan, implementation of key programs, compliance with all The Coca-Cola Company Standards and local regulations. This will require extensive use of standardized procedures, processes, technologies and equipment and will require close collaboration with other members of the Local Leadership Teams implementing agreed strategies in the Plant.
- Foster a safety-focused environment and promote an engaged safety culture
- Work closely with stakeholders to understand potential gaps, identify opportunities of improvement, and execute mitigation action plans to ensure full operational compliance to KORE expectations.
- Cultivate a culture that values operational excellence through continuous process improvement.
- Adopt and share best practices from within and outside the company.
- Demonstrate behaviors necessary for effective change implementation.
- Ensure manufacturing processes comply with company specifications and customer expectations.
- Meet the needs and service requirements of both internal and external customers.
- Ensure compliance with company and regulatory policies.
- Represent the company responsibly in community affairs and maintain environmentally sustainable efforts.
- Oversee budget preparation, planning, and financial performance monitoring to ensure facility meets or exceeds budgetary commitments.
- Analyze reports and recommend operational activities to achieve optimal performance and annual key performance indicators.
- Lead site audits process and drive compliance with ISO and KORE standards
- Develop partnership with finance, marketing, supply chain services and labor relations for business growth and governance

Education and/or Experience
- 10+ years' experience in a manufacturing environment is required
- 5+ years' experience in leadership roles for value added aseptic beverage processing/Fluid Milk or Juices required
- Bachelor’s Degree; Engineering, Food Science, Dairy Science, Science required, with proven knowledge of beverage manufacturing, dairy knowledge is highly desirable
- Experience leading and managing multi-million dollar capital projects required
- Experience working in a unionized environment preferred
- Experience working under manufacturing operating models based on KPIs, Continuous Improvement tools, Quality Tools and Gap Closure Action Plans
- Leadership experience within complex manufacturing facilities
- Working knowledge of Food Safety Principles, CFIA/PMO/OMAFRA/DFO/local and other regulations an asset
- Ability to implement fundamental TQM and Lean Manufacturing principals across the operations
- Good Understanding of GMPs, CIP operations, functionality and chemistry
- Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
- Excellent organizational and multi-tasking skills
- Demonstrated leadership experience and success working in a fast-paced environment, managing 24/7 operations
- Understanding of key business drivers for gauging effectiveness and performance of groups and suppliers
- Proficiency in SAP and MS Office
- Business acumen and strategic problem-solving abilities
- Strong influencing and negotiation skills
